mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.salt, u.nickname, u.role_code, u.permissions, u.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.failed_login_count, u.lock_time, u.must_change_password, u.credential_expires_at, u.credential_consumed_at, u.default_logistics_company, u.create_time, u.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_admin_user u LEFT JOIN dms_merchant m ON m.id=u.merchant_id WHERE u.username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM dms_admin_user u LEFT JOIN dms_merchant m ON m.id=u.merchant_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND ((#{portal} = 'PLATFORM' AND u.merchant_id IS NULL) OR (#{portal} = 'MERCHANT' AND u.merchant_id IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_admin_user (username, password_hash, salt, nickname, role_code, permissions, merchant_id, status, must_change_password, credential_expires_at, credential_consumed_at, default_logistics_company) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{salt}, #{nickname}, #{roleCode}, #{permissions}, #{merchantId}, #{status}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{credentialExpiresAt}, #{credentialConsumedAt}, #{defaultLogisticsCompany})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_admin_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, role_code = #{roleCode}, permissions = #{permissions}, merchant_id = #{merchantId}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE dms_admin_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, salt = #{salt}, must_change_password = #{mustChangePassword}, credential_expires_at = CASE WHEN #{mustChangePassword}=0 THEN NULL ELSE credential_expires_at END, credential_consumed_at = CASE WHEN #{mustChangePassword}=0 THEN NULL ELSE credential_consumed_at END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE dms_admin_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, salt = #{salt}, must_change_password = 1, credential_expires_at = #{credentialExpiresAt}, credential_consumed_at = NULL, failed_login_count = 0, lock_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE dms_admin_user SET credential_consumed_at = #{now}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND must_change_password = 1 AND credential_consumed_at IS NULL AND credential_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND credential_expires_at > #{now}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET default_logistics_company=#{defaultLogisticsCompany}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET failed_login_count=failed_login_count+1, lock_time=CASE WHEN failed_login_count+1 >= #{lockThreshold} THEN NOW() ELSE lock_time END, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET failed_login_count=0, lock_time=NULL, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
